$comment: High and critical npm advisories accepted in the clean npm-consumer graph (scripts/check-package-consumers.mjs). Each entry needs the GHSA id, why it is unreachable or acceptable, and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the gate fails again. Prefer fixing the dependency.

advisories.reason: Zod memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections, fixed only in 4.6.6; zod 3 has no patched release. Gezel's own packages use zod 4. The zod 3 copies come from @atproto/* (zod ^3.23.8 in every release; validates Bluesky connector responses) and @bendyline/docblocks-cli, which pins zod 3.25.76 exactly in every 2.7.x release (validates tool arguments in its own child process). Clears when DocBlocks moves to zod 4; atproto has no fix to take.
